title: 32 GB graphics cards
evidence: Being decided (O112): Qwen3.5 9B in 16-bit at 16K against 9B QLoRA (the 24 GB recipe) by their comparisons with the starting 9B and the card's free memory at night. 16-bit, measured on an RTX 5090 under a 26,085 MiB cap: 7.8 s/step, 26,401 MiB on the card at its peak, 35.9 GB of commit, gradient norms 0.2-0.5, loss 0.33, no spill; ready in Row-Bot's own server. Qwen3.8 27B needs a card with nothing else on it: not certified for 5.4 (O107).
